acceptance: A real failed run is re-run with --failed and a run with a cancelled job is re-run in full, with output recorded
Refusal paths (running CI, shared head, retarget) shown live or marked untestable
Any field mismatch fixed with a test
context: Gap from closing out PR #3109; its unit tests alone do not prove the live behaviour.
description: scripts/pr_rerun.py was merged with 24 unit tests against a fake gh. It was never run against a real failed CI run: the REST fields (path, head_repository.full_name, base_ref_changed timeline events, job conclusions) and the rerun / rerun --failed calls are unverified live. The 'not-a-text-edit-run' rule relies on ci-paths being skipped, which was only observed on the probe PR.
